name: Kingston Flemings
detail: Flemings (back tightness) will not return to Friday's game against the Bulls.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Keshon Gilbert
detail: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

name: Asa Newell
detail: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

name: Paul George
detail: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

name: Mikel Brown Jr.
detail: Brown (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Saturday's game at Memphis.

name: Nolan Traore
detail: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

name: Brandon Miller
detail: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

name: Tobe Awaka
detail: Awaka has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Nic Claxton
detail: Claxton (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Jalen Smith
detail: Smith (finger) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game at Minnesota.

name: Norman Powell
detail: Powell (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

name: Caleb Wilson
detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Evan Mobley
detail: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Max Christie
detail: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.

name: Morez Johnson Jr.
detail: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.

name: Dereck Lively II
detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

name: Sergio de Larrea
detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

name: Stephen Curry
detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Marcus Smart
detail: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Aaron Nesmith
detail: Nesmith exited to the locker room in the final seconds of Friday's 106-104 win over the Knicks due to an apparent hand/wrist injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports. He posted 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist in 33 minutes.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Quentin Grimes
detail: Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.

name: Austin Reaves
detail: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

name: Luka Doncic
detail: Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine," per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Collin Sexton
detail: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

name: Quinten Post
detail: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

name: Zach Edey
detail: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.

name: Pelle Larsson
detail: Larsson (illness) is listed as doubtful for Saturday's game against Detroit.

name: Klay Thompson
detail: Thompson (ankle) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Pistons.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
detail: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Detroit.

name: Yves Missi
detail: Missi (knee) has been upgraded to probable for Saturday's game versus the Nuggets.

name: Trendon Watford
detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Denver.

name: Bryce McGowens
detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Trey Murphy III
detail: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Dejounte Murray
detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

name: Ajay Mitchell
detail: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Thomas Sorber
detail: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Jaylin Williams
detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

name: Noah Penda
detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: LeBron James
detail: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

name: Dominick Barlow
detail: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

name: Adem Bona
detail: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

name: Drew Timme
detail: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

name: Vit Krejci
detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Precious Achiuwa
detail: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

name: Scottie Barnes
detail: Barnes (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
detail: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
detail: Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Jaxson Hayes
detail: Hayes won't return to Friday's game against the Rockets due to a left knee issue.

name: Trey Alexander
detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Lauri Markkanen
detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Bub Carrington
detail: Carrington (chest) has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's game against the Pistons.
